citation: Mengozzi A, Biancalana E, Parolini F, et al. Normal Versus Slowly Processed Pasta and Post-Prandial Glucose Homeostasis in Healthy Subjects: A Pilot Study. Nutrients. 2021;13(2):678.
protocol: Mixed-meal test with normally processed or slowly processed pasta (composition in methods), crossover. Blood at 0, 15, 30, 60, 90, 120, 150, 180 min.
note: Pasta-based Mediterranean mixed meal with insulin, GIP and GLP-1 together in pmol units. The statistics section says mean ± SD (or median [IQR] where stated). Read the meal grams from the methods. Only in figures: full time courses. Meal kinds: mixed meal.
